name: journal-entries-attachment-da
expected_behavior: Reads kvittering.pdf and takes the amount (500 kr. incl. 100 kr. VAT), the expense type, and the card payment from it
Looks up the expense and card/bank accounts in the chart of accounts instead of using account numbers from memory
Proposes a balanced entry for the receipt's 500 kr. total (with or without a separate VAT line)
Asks whether to attach the PDF to the entry in the same turn as the confirmation receipt (an AskUserQuestion attempt or a question in the text), not after the entry exists
Shows a confirmation receipt and stops to ask the user to confirm before posting
